reviewer.role: bounded independent executable Discovery semantic reviewer

scope: Read-only executable review of the current frozen discovery_plan.py, discovery_candidates.py and discovery_graph.py against the frozen R2-R7 contracts. Probed conflicted-seed capability handling, depth-2 non-recursion, alias attempt suppression, explicit unseen-neighbor slices, and durable three-lineage merge/no-refund behavior. discovery.py and discovery_storage.py wiring were not modified. No source, test, schema, Git, network, connector, Vault or human-gate mutation.

external_probe.method: One isolated Python probe creates only temporary /private/tmp synthetic documents and calls the current production helpers. It records pass/fail/error for each vector and hashes the three reviewed source files at execution time.

checks.contract: R5/R6/R7 conflicted components remain inspectable and are excluded from executable frontier expansion.
checks.evidence: An OpenAlex W1 seed was joined to W2 through an explicit same_work link. frontier() returned no specs and 13 capability entries, all reason identity_conflicted; no DISCOVERY_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED escaped.

checks.contract: R6/R7 expansion depth is one plus minimum why-found depth, bounded at depth 2, and a depth-2 selection never recurses.
checks.evidence: With all 11 base specs marked attempted and a distinct candidate whose why-found depth was 1, frontier() emitted one depth-2 expanded lookup. Replaying with that depth-2 spec attempted emitted no further expanded spec.

checks.contract: R6/R7 logical plain-job suppression ignores alias extension while explicit retry/continuation remain separate paths.
checks.evidence: A committed W1 lookup and citations base spec was followed by an observation joining W1 to a DOI alias. frontier() returned neither a new plain lookup nor a plain citations job for the alias-expanded subject.

checks.contract: R6 explicit references/related slices use the singleton continuation and exact unseen canonical prefix.
checks.evidence: A W123 singleton exposed 25 canonical referenced IDs. The first automatic batch contained 20; validate_explicit accepted exactly the remaining five and rejected a slice that reintroduced an already-used first ID.

checks.contract: R7 durable selection history retains three introductions after alias/bridge merge and refuses a fourth distinct introduction.
checks.evidence: Three depth-1 origin lineages were created for distinct components. A same_work bridge joined the first two and a later spec reused that component without changing lineage count; a fourth disjoint subject raised DISCOVERY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

limitations_and_remaining_gates: The probe is focused on the five requested semantic vectors; it does not replace the parent full local, wheel or CI evidence.
No live provider, real-data, Vault/admin or human scientific gate was exercised.
The prior R2 control-group concern was withdrawn in discovery-semantic-wip-review-r2-supplement.json after its separate rejection/valid-history probe.
conclusion: All five independently executed semantic vectors passed against the exact current three-module hashes. The previously reported conflicted-seed frontier finding is closed in the current discovery_plan.py; this review reports no remaining actual finding in the requested scope.
